s: Din diqduq ketibatan ubo v' seipim: lekattechilla tzarik liktob ketiba tamma ushelema bitmunat haotiyyot, shellemaduha middibre hattalmud umidrashim veqabbala meharishonim. Abal im shinna — lo pasal, ella im ken hipsid tzurat haot legamre kemo sheyyitbaer:

Zo temunat haotiyyot: — tzerika lihyot hannequdda haelyona asuya keyu"d, ulepikak tzarik lihyot bah shelosha oqatzim kemo beyu"d, oqetz echad lemala lekattechilla, ushenayim lematta, echad miyyamin hannogea begag haale"p, veim lav — pesula kemo sheyyitbaer, veechad missemol lekattechilla, vehu lo yihyeh nogea begaggah, veim naga — keshera, kemo shennitbaer siman lab. Veyu"d zo tzerika lihyot lekattechilla sheyyihyeh paneha im oqatzeha shellemala hapukim qetzat kelappe mala. Veqabbala mehechasid shettehe regel yu"d zo nogaat baale"p lekattechilla beemtza gaggah, velo beqatzehu. Vesop haggag shel tzad yamin tzarik lekattechilla sheyyehe aqom qetzat kelappe mala, velo yehe aqom harbeh. Unequdda hattachtona, peamim shettemunatah kedale"t qetanna hapuka al pi hassod, veken tzarik lihyot battepillin al pi qabbalat haari"y za"l, upeamim shettemunatah gam ken keyu"d teluya betagah begup haale"p, velaken lekattechilla tzarik sheyyehe lah oqetz qatan letzad yamin lematta, veal pi hassod tzarik sheyyehe oqetz zeh mekuvvan keneged oqetz haelyon sheal hayyu"d haelyona. — (Al pi hassod tzerika lihyot merubbaat lemala kemo dale"t velo agulla kere"sh) tzarik lizzaher battag shelleachareha lerabbeah, shello tehe niret keka"p, veim niret keka"p — pesula. Veim sapeq — azay marin letinoq. Vetzarik lekattechilla sheyyehe lah beroshah mitztzad semol tag qatan. Veal pi haqqabbala yehe lah aqeb ab lematta, ki temunatah kemo dale"t tok garon shel va"v, al ken tzarik sheyyihyeh lah zavit lemala shettehe kemo dale"t, veaqeb tob lematta sheyyehe bimqom rosho shel va"v. — Tzarik sheyyehe roshah ab, veregel yamin daqqa tihyeh lekattechilla, veyoredet meat lematta yoter miyyerek semol, veyerek semol lo tihyeh aqumma ella meshuka beshaveh umugbahat qetzat kelappe dale"t lekattechilla. Veyesh mi sheqqabbala beyado sheggup haggime"l yihyeh kemo zayi"n, sheyyimshok regel yamin meemtza harosh velo miqqatzehu kemo bevay"v, veken kol rashe semol shebbeotiyyot sha"t n"z g"tz yihyu domin lezayi"n, veal ken hattagi"n shealehen niqreu zay"nin. Abal qabbalat haari"y za"l eno ken, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyerek semol tehe nemuka, kede lehamshik ot etzel rosh haggime"l, ki ken qabbala mehechasid. Veliksheyyiktob va"v etzel nu"n kepupa — yiktebenna betok kepipat hannu"n, kede lehasmik rashehen zeh etzel zeh. Ukesheyyiktob k' peshuta etzel tzadi"y kepupa — tob leaqqem tzavvar hatztzadi"y meat letzad yamin, kede sheyyiqrab qetzat ka"p happeshuta lerashe hatztzadi"y, abal beli tzorek lo yeaqqem shum ot, ki ken qabbala meharishonim sheyyehe kullam baamida peshutim, velo muttim lo leyamin velo lismol. — Tzarik sheyyehe gaggah arok veraglah qetzara, sheim tehe raglah arukka miggaggah — tidmeh leka"p peshuta vetippasel keshello yiqraenna hattinoq dale"t. Ulekattechilla tzarik shettehe haregel peshuta beshippua qetzat letzad yamin, vesheyyehe lah tag qatan berosh gaggah mitztzad semol. Vetzarik lizzaher battag shellaachoreha lerabbeah, shello tehe niret kere"sh, vetippasel al yede qeriat hattinoq. Veyesh mi sheqqabbala beyado sheeno day sheyyehe lah zaviyyot chadda millaachoreha, ella lekattechilla yehe lah sham aqeb tob, ki temunatah kemo shene va"vi"n segurim, veheaqeb hu neged rosh havvay"v echad. Veyaaseh gam ken oqetz qatan letzad yamin bolet al paneha lemala, veoqetz zeh hu keneged rosh havvay"v hashsheni. — Tzarik laasot lah lekattechilla tag qatan lemala mitztzad semol, vegam baachoreha yaaseh oqetz qatan shettehe merubbaat kemo dale"t velo agulla keresh. Vehannequdda shebbetokah lo tehe semuka legaggah, ella yehe benehem chalaq kol kak bikde sheadam benoni yakkirennu heteb meal seper tora sheal gabbe habbima kesheqqore bo, veim noga mammash begaggah apillu negia daqqa kechut hassaara — pesula. Velo tehe hannequdda neged emtza haggag ella neged sopo betzad semol, veim asaah baemtza — pesula, vetzarik letaqqenah, ella im ken en tiqqun moil — azay yesh lehakshir apillu lekattechilla kemo shennitbaer siman lab. Veyesh mi sheqqabbala beyado shehannequdda tehe daqqa lemala veaba qetzat lematta keen yu"d, ki temunat haHashem hu dale"t veyu"d (bekol hahe"yin, chutz mehahe"yin shel shem havaya"h baruk hu, sheyyesh bahem qabbala acheret kemo sheyyitbaer). Vetihyeh hannequdda aqumma lematta letzad yamin, velo letzad semol, pen tidmeh letay"v. — Tzarik lihyot roshah qatzar, shello tidmeh lere"sh, veraglah arukka, shello tidmeh leyu"d vetippasel al yede qeriat hattinoq. Vetob shettihyeh agulla letzad yamin beroshah, shello tidmeh lezayi"n. Veap al pi sherosh hazzayi"n ober mishshene tzedadin, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma tinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh yiqraenna zayi"n vetippasel. Veal pi hassod tzarik lihyot raglah peshuta beshaveh, veobyah mitmaet veholek meat meat, ad shettehe chadda lematta. Veal pi qabbalat haari"y za"l tzarik lihyot oqetz qatan mitztzad semol berosh kol havva"vin shebbattepillin, velo beseper tora. — Tzarik lizzaher shello tehe raglah arukka, shello yitdammeh lenu"n peshuta vetippasel al yede qeriat hattinoq, veroshah tzarik lihyot ober mishshene tzedadin shello tidmeh levay"v, veyihyeh merubba — al pi hassod. — Lekattechilla tzarik laasot lah chatotarot al gabbe shette ragleha, vegam tag qatan berosh regel semol, abal regel yamin yihyeh rosho agol letzad yamin lekattechilla, ushette ragleha tzerikim lihyot kishne zay"nin lekattechilla. Veal pi qabbalat haari"y za"l tzerika lihyot regel haymanit kemo vay"v battepillin, veqav hachatotarot sheal regel hayyamin yihyeh ab, vesheal regel hassemol yihyeh daq. Veim heerik hache"t ad shennishtanna tzurat hazzay"nin legamre, apillu asa dale"t vezayi"n vachatotarot al gabbo — pesula, ubattepillin en lah tiqqun, mishshum shello kesidran. Abal im lo asa lah chatotarot kelal, apillu heerikah harbeh — keshera bediabad. — Tzarik sheyyihyeh rosh yamin shellah kapup meat lematta lekattechilla, abal lo yihyeh kapup harbeh lekattechilla, verosh semol shellah yihyeh kezayi"n (ledibre hammatzrikim ken bekol otiyyot shatn"z g"tz, abal lepi qabbalat haari"y za"l tihyeh kevay"v yeshara battepillin). Abal rosh yamin lekattechilla yihyeh agol kevay"v, velo yehe rauy lehoshib alayv kitre hattagin, sheim rosh rishon haya shaveh vehagun lattagin kemo rosh hashsheni — lo hayu medallegin alayv lehoshibam barosh hashsheni, domeh lemah sheameru: "en maabirin al hammitzvot". Umittaam zeh kol hayyu"din shebbetzad yamin beayi"n vetzadi"y veshi"n shebbeseper tora kullam penehem kelappe mala, veen reuyin lehoshib alehen kitre hattagin. — Tzarik lihyot aleha tag qatan milmala lekattechilla, vetzarik laasot roshah kapup bismolo lematta sheyyihyeh kemo oqetz qatan yored lematta, veyihyeh oqetz zeh qatzar meraglah pen tidmeh leche"t, veraglah yihyeh kapup qetzat lekattechilla lehetib tzuratah, veyihyeh regel qatan velo gadol pen tidmeh lere"sh. Veyihyeh qatzar velo arok shello tidmeh levay"v vetippasel al yede qeriat hattinoq, veim chaser uqtzah hassemali, veen tzarik lomar raglah haymanit — pesula, ubassemali moil tiqqun apillu bitpillin, abal lo bayyemini kemo shennitbaer besiman lab. Kepupa — qabbalat hechasid shehi tzerika lihyot agulla mikkol tzad, velo yihyeh lah shum zaviyyot lekattechilla, veim asa lah zavit baachoreha milmala — keshera im hi agulla lematta. Abal im asa millematta umilmala — hare zo doma lebe"t upesula. Peshuta — tzarik lihyot gaggah qatzar, shello tidmeh lere"sh, laken lo yimshok otah besop hashshita. Veap al pi shekkol haotiyyot en lemoshkan, mikkol maqom bediabad kesherot, abal zo pesula, im tinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh eno qoreah kehilkatah. Ulekattechilla tzarik lihyot kol happeshutot arukkot keshiur sheim nikpelu yihyu kepupot. Umittaam zeh lo yaaseh leka"p peshuta zaviyyot lemala, ella tihyeh agulla kemo re"sh, sheim kopepin otah shetteaseh ka"p kepupa, sheen chilluq benehem, raq shezzo kepupa vezo peshuta. Veim asa lah zaviyyot lemala kemo dale"t — pesula, veen lah tiqqun bitpillin umezuzot, sheddinah kere"sh sheasaah kemo dale"t shetztzarik ligror et kullah, kemo shennitbaer besiman lab. — Tzarik lihyot tzavvaro arok kevay"v, verosho agol letzad yamin, uletzad semol zaviyyot lerosho kemo shehu rosh havvay"v, ki temunat hallame"d hi kemo ka"p kepupa vealeha vay"v. Umittaam zeh yihyeh zenabah ab vekapup heteb lepaneha, vetihyeh agulla meachareha letzad yamin keka"p kepupa. Abal letzad semol meqom chibbur gupah vetzavvarah — yihyeh lah zaviyyot ben sop havvay"v sheyyored bedaqqut letzurat ka"p. Vekol zeh lekattechilla. Veal pi hassod tzarik lihyot lah shene tagin al rosh tzavvarah, yeminah — gadol, usemolah — qatan. Petucha ume"m setuma — tzarik sheyyihyu shavin lekattechilla bekol haykolet, shehare shettehen niqraot me"min, ella shezzo me"m petucha vezo me"m setuma. Velaken en laasot me"m petucha agulla lemala ulematta betzad yamin, sheim yaaseh bassetuma shemma yitdammeh lesame"ke letinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh (veod ki haotiyyot tzerikim lihyot nikkarot miyyad kesheroin otan biriyya qalla velo ad sheyyistakkel bahen qetzat), ella tihyeh lahen zaviyyot lematta betzad yamin lekattechilla. Abal lemala — yesh sheosin sham agullot lekattechilla, kede shettihyeh temunat hamme"m petucha keka"p kepupa uvay"v. Umittaam zeh en osin gag agol, ella maarikim otah beshaveh ad keneged qetzeh moshab hattachton, sheal yede ken domeh gupah leka"p kepupa. Veyesh sheosin otah sham merubbaat, venimtza temunat hamme"m petucha hi shene va"vin. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Vehachartom tzarik sheyyaggia ad keneged moshab hattachton, kede sheyyihyeh rauy listom, utemunato lekattechilla hi kemo vay"v omedet mutta qetzat velo harbeh, velaken lo yihyeh happegam shebben haggag uben rosh hachartom gadol kol-kak sheyyitztarek limshok mimmenna beaqmimut, velo yihyeh vay"v omedet. Setuma — kebar nitbaer sheyyesh laasotah agulla betzad yamin lekattechilla abal lo lematta, vegaggah yihyeh ober michutz lassetima koobi qulemos, ki zehu shiur hannequdda shel me"m happetucha, ki me"m setuma gam ken temunatah ka"p uvay"v kemo happetucha, ella shehavvay"v sotamtah. — Yehe roshah kezayi"n, lepi shetztzerika lihyot shava lenu"n peshuta bekol haykolet lekattechilla, shehare shettehen niqraot nu"nin ella shezzo kepupa vezo peshuta, vehappeshuta tzerika lihyot gam ken beinyan sheim tikpepenna tihyeh kepupa kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyihyeh harosh qatzar, umoshabah hattachton mashuk letzad semol heteb yoter min harosh shello tidmeh lebe"t, vetzavvarah qetzat arok, kede lehasmik ot etzel roshah kemo shekkatub lemala, vetihyeh agulla gam millematta letzad yamin. Veken kol haotiyyot hakkepupot — tzerikim lihyot lekattechilla agullot lematta, sheim tepashshetenna tihyeh peshuta. Peshuta — toar tzuratah kemo zayi"n, ak shehi arukka keshiur shettehe reuya leheasot nu"n kepupa im tikpepenna, kemo shennitbaer lemala beka"p peshuta. Veim hi qetzara — marin letinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh, veim qoreah zayi"n — pesula. — Tzarik shettehe milmala gaggah shaveh lekattechilla, ki hi mechubberet mishte otiyyot: ka"p kepupa debuqa im vay"v besopah. Vetzarik shettehe agulla bishloshet zaviyyoteha. Vegaggah lemala yehe lekattechilla ober chutz lassetima koobi qulemos, shehu shiur gaggo shel vay"v haddebuqa besopah. — Yihyeh rosh harishon keen yu"d sheppaneha meat lemala, mittaam shennitbaer lemala beot t. Vegupah yihyeh baamida, kede sheyyukal lehasmik ot etzlah. Verosh hashsheni hu kemo zayi"n omed bah, mittaam shennitbaer lemala sham. Abal al pi qabbalat haari"y za"l yihyeh shene qavvin shel haay"nin shebbattepillin kishte va"vin yesharot. Kepupa — qabbala mehechasid laasot lah zaviyyot lekattechilla lemala betzad yamin mibbipnim umibbachutz. Abal lematta tihyeh agulla mibbachutz, kemo kol hakkepupot shetztzarik lihyot agullot lematta lekattechilla. Abal mibbipnim sham tehe lah zaviyyot, kede sheyyehe ballaban shebbipnim tzurat be"t, ki ken qabbala mehechasid. Peshuta — tzerika lihyot agulla lemala betzad yamin lekattechilla, kemo shehakkepupa hi lematta. Abal qabbalat hechasid laasotah merubbaat lemala, kemo shehakkepupa hi lemala. Utzerika lihyot arukka lekattechilla keshiur shettihyeh reuya leheasot pe"a kepupa im tikpepenna. Kepupa — roshah harishon yehe kapup qetzat kelappe mala, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Virekah yadbiq beemtza tzavvara, velo lematta pen tidmeh leayi"n. Veroshah hashsheni kemo zayi"n, mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Vetzavvarah qetzat arok, kede lehasmik ot etzel roshah. Umoshabah mashuk letzad semol heteb, ki toar gupah hi kemo nu"n kepupa veyu"d aleha. Vetihyeh agulla lematta betzad yamin lekattechilla, kemo bekol hakkepupot. Veal pi qabbalat haari"y za"l kol hatztzadi"y shebbitpillin yehe rosh yamin kemo yu"d hapuka usemolah nu"n kepupa. Peshuta — tehe roshah kemo shel kepupa. Veraglah tered lematta middibbuq harashim lekattechilla, bikde sheyyehe rauy laasotah kepupa. — Tzarik lihyot tag qatan al gaggah betzad semol lekattechilla. Virekah haymanit tzerika lihyot aqumma heteb letzad regel semol hatteluya. Veyesh limshok regel semol hatteluya baalakson qetzat letzad yamin. — Tihyeh agulla mammash meachoreha lemala, shello tidmeh ledale"t vetippasel al yede qeriat hattinoq. Virekah qatzar, shello tidmeh leka"p peshuta vetippasel al yede qeriat hattinoq. — Shene rasheha harishonim yihyu keen yu"d sheppaneha lemala, mittaam shennitbaer lemala, veroshah hashshelishi keen zayi"n mittaam shennitbaer sham. Ulepi qabbalat haari"y za"l kol hashshi"nin shebbattepillin yihyu shelosha qavvin keshalosh va"vin yesharot. Vetzarik ledabbeq rosh haemtzai letzad semol lematta, velo yehe moshab rachab lematta ella chad letzad semol lekattechilla, veaz yihyu kol hashshelosha rashim omedim lematta al regel achat, kemo haqqu"p vehare"sh. — Qabbala meharishonim sheyyihyeh gaggah im regel yamin kemo dale"t. Veregel semol — yesh sheosin keen vay"v hapuka, veyesh sheosin kemo dale"t qetanna hahapuka. Vekol maqom shehahalaka ropepet beyadeka — hallek achar hamminhag. Vekol zeh lekattechilla:

Kol haotiyyot tzerikim lihyot golem echad, kegon yu"de haale"p, vehaayi"n, vehappe"a, vehatztzadi"y, vehashshi"n, veragle hattay"v — tzerikim lihyot nogeot baot, ubeachat sheenah nogaat pesulin hattepillin ad sheyyetaqqenu, veen qeriat hattinoq moelet bazeh kemo shennitbaer besiman lab. Veken me"m setuma vesame"ke tzerikin lihyot mudbaqot usemukot legamre, vaapillu perud daq kechut hassaara posel bahem. Veken bishar otiyyot, chutz meregel haHashem vehaqqu"p, sheen lahem ligga, veim nageu — pesulin hattepillin, veen tiqqun moil bahen kemo shennitbaer sham:

Kol ot sheyyesh bah sapeq: shemma en bah kashshiur harauy beinyan shehi pesula, o shemma en tzuratah aleha beinyan shehi pesula — marin letinoq sheeno chakam velo tippesh, veim yodea liqrotah kehilkatah — keshera. Abal im yadua lanu sheen haot kehilkatah — en qeriat hattinoq moelet kemo shennitbaer besiman lab:

Otiyyot shatn"z g"tz, vehu haddin nu"n peshuta vetzadi"y kepupa bekol maqom shehem — tzarik lezayyenan bishlosha tagin qetannim, vetzarik sheyyihyu hattagin nogeim begup haotiyyot, vekol echad niprad mechabero, veim enan nogein begup haot o shennogein zeh bazeh — pesulin, vetzarik letaqqenan lekattechilla. Abal bediabad apillu lo asa lahen kelal tagin — kesherin. Veyesh poselin im lo tiyyeg shatn"z g"tz. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lehachamir beshel tora uletaqqenan. Vaapillu bitpillin moil tiqqun, veen bazeh mishshum shello kesidran, hoil vegup haot tzurato alayv:
Venahagu hassoperim laasot od tagin bekamma meqomot, veen chashash bazeh. Raq sheyyizzaharu meod kesheosin al hayyu"d o al havva"v sheyyaasu tagin daqqin, shello titqalqel tzurot havva"v o hayyu"d:
